fact: UNICEF's national sub-office head says Chad has worked since 2021 to modernise civil registration through digitalisation and deployment of the TASDJIL application.
ANATS and the OIF discussed digitalisation and interoperability of civil registration services between communes and the SIGPTS, with ANATS issuing secure birth certificates in several provinces.
An ATPE opinion piece says the TASDJIL system of Technidev and ANATS already digitally registers births at a hospital desk at Koukou Angarana in Sila province, with experiences still to be scaled up.
